name: BONHOMME
based: Travelling the world for more than 30 years
bio:
In the Cathar lands of southern France, people called the members of a brotherhood of absolute goodness bonshommes: good men. BONHOMME carries that name into club culture: music made by hand, honestly, in service of art.

Genre doesn't matter. What matters is that the music is good and the sound is perfect.

On the road since I was seven, at judo competitions in Finland. Fighting sports took me across Europe, Russia and Georgia, until I became Estonia's first MMA champion in 2015. Music took me inside the underground: Berlin, San Francisco, LA and Tallinn, ecstatic dance communities and high-level festivals.

At festivals I have been assistant to the deco team leader, a light and sound technician, and above all a dancer who holds the room from the floor, in unity, kindness and safety. Pure love for the right people and the music. I always watch for the artist who needs help, and I will do anything in my power to help them deliver the art.
offers:
- Make a good track sound perfect: mix, master, fix the sound.
- Produce: from a rough idea or a voice memo to a finished track.
- DJ: read the room and carry the night, from warm-up to peak time, and most importantly the afters.
- Hold the room from the dance floor: unity, kindness and safety.
- Crew: deco, lights and sound. Whatever the artist needs to deliver the art.
- Coach 1:1, in fighting or any field, for people whose intention is to become the best. I choose my students carefully.
- Fight: Estonia's first MMA champion (2015, 77.1 kg), judo 2nd dan, BJJ blue belt. Wherever I travel, I visit a gym and spar.
- Collaborate anywhere. More than 30 years on the road, in Estonian and English.
- Sail. I'm a licensed skipper, so the studio can be a boat.
- Build tools for artists: Unleashed and Rhyme Rumble.
looking_for:
- People who breathe music, who are driven by it, whatever they play or make.
- An unleash together brings the energy to face the rest of life.
- Got a good track, but the sound is shit? That ends here. Send it.
- Rooms, parties, raves and boats to play.
creates:
I'm an artist because my mission is to recognise and support art, mine and everyone's.
Goals:
- A collab in every place I go.
- All my music free for DJs worldwide.
- Scene raves, parties and youth rap battles in Tallinn.
- A network of artists who help each other and all get paid when the art earns.
